semanticScenarios.given: Player blocks the previously forecast route before the result is applied
semanticScenarios.expected: Invalidate affected branch/read set; impossible old route is not enacted; recompose from current state

semanticScenarios.given: Hypothetical branch consumes a tool or finishes a handoff
semanticScenarios.expected: Only branch state changes; no live memory, reservation, inventory, receipt or decisionSeq mutation

semanticScenarios.given: Actor-perspective request includes facts only another actor or world predictor knows
semanticScenarios.expected: Reject/filter before dispatch; hypothetical actor observes its own branch-local evidence only

semanticScenarios.given: Cause fact ID or parameterSetId is absent from the bound snapshot/rules registry
semanticScenarios.expected: Reject before inference/application; no fabricated cause, numeric parameter or effect

semanticScenarios.given: Schema-valid next_environment request refers to a real but no longer current cause
semanticScenarios.expected: Live writer revalidates cause, timing, rules and read set; no future-to-present promotion

semanticScenarios.given: Same forecast/branch/step key repeats after cache eviction or forecast closure
semanticScenarios.expected: Coalesce or return retained result; expired identity returns 410, never reinfer or reset the closed forecast

semanticScenarios.given: Snapshot times are individually valid decimal strings but stepTickUs precedes basisTickUs or exceeds horizon
semanticScenarios.expected: Reject ordering/horizon violation; strings alone are not sufficient validation

semanticScenarios.given: A 19-digit tick exceeds signed Int64 maximum
semanticScenarios.expected: Reject before C# conversion; no overflow or rounding

semanticScenarios.given: Probabilities have duplicate IDs, sum 0.7, or choose an absent/nonmaximal candidate
semanticScenarios.expected: Reject invalid provider result; no silent normalization or candidate substitution

semanticScenarios.given: No player command is issued while NPC needs, commitments and observable opportunities exist
semanticScenarios.expected: Agent selects a grounded goal and acts; observes results and revises blocked plans without central scene commands

semanticScenarios.given: Future expansion saturates the shared queue while live NPCs need decisions
semanticScenarios.expected: One global budget with bounded admission and fair service; no duplicated endpoint quota or runaway branch calls

semanticScenarios.given: Recorded model outcomes are replayed versus new online calls with the same seed
semanticScenarios.expected: Recorded semantic transition sequence is reproducible within supported engine scope; fresh API answers are not assumed identical

semanticScenarios.given: Forecast imagines a player intervention or NPC choice that was never actually made
semanticScenarios.expected: Do not generate player input or force real NPC plan; only eligible immediate environmental intent may reach live gate

semanticScenarios.given: No grounded model candidate exists, or causal/physics coupling is unsupported
semanticScenarios.expected: Report blocked/incomplete/truncated scope; no invented candidates, static script fallback or false forecast completion

semanticScenarios.given: Unchanged failed plan repeatedly proposes the same unavailable resource
semanticScenarios.expected: Suppress unchanged repeated inference; keep explicit blocked state or seek actual new information/alternatives

semanticScenarios.given: EnvironmentTransitionIntent key repeats with the same or different effect fingerprint
semanticScenarios.expected: Same fingerprint reuses one commit result; different fingerprint conflicts; no duplicated environmental effect

semanticScenarios.given: Two independent JEV questions produce incompatible possible futures
semanticScenarios.expected: Preserve conditional alternatives or requery sequentially; do not commit contradictions or multiply values into an asserted real-world joint probability

semanticScenarios.given: Late unavailable response arrives for an expired branch after a newer request starts
semanticScenarios.expected: Account trusted known usage once; close only the matching old request; leave live/new branch state unchanged

semanticScenarios.given: A world candidate set includes env-hold/hold/none with no causes and source/target bound to the same read-set entity
semanticScenarios.expected: Admit this no-effect alternative without inventing a causal fact; selecting it preserves the exact world state. Reject a missing anchor, different bindings, actor ownership, alternate hold identity/parameters, or any other transition with empty causes.

semanticScenarios.given: Multiple branches repeat candidate IDs, have different hypothetical entity revisions, or offer more than 32 choices in aggregate
semanticScenarios.expected: Forecast registration deduplicates the root entity union and uses actual basis revisions, bounded to 64 entities. Each individual future step still requires 2..32 unique candidates; branch choices and hypothetical revisions are never mistaken for one root choice.

semanticScenarioExecution: NOT_RUN: requires implemented dynamic candidate builder, broker, isolated rollout, autonomous agents and causal kernel; artifact validation checks shapes only.
